reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker recruits viewers through a link to deposit Bitcoin, exchange it for BitConnect tokens, commit at least $100 to lending, and join a referral structure that rewards him from their investments. The solicitation includes unusually large projected returns, such as 242% interest on $100 over 299 days and a claimed 180% return on $5,010 over 179 days. The speaker's denial that it is a scam and general responsible-investing caution do not substantiate the projections, and the available video evidence does not establish whether any return was paid or funds were recovered.

citations.quote: Go and hit that link to get started.
BitConnect is a trading platform that takes your Bitcoins in exchange for BitConnect tokens and lends these BitConnect tokens out into the market.

if you lend out $100 loan in 299 days, for which big connect will be holding your loan and lending your loan out into the market you will receive a two hundred and forty two percent return of interest
Some days we'll be high, some days we'll be low.
if we take $5,010 of an amount that you want to lend out into the market in 179 days, you will have made $9,057.58 in profit. That's 180% ROI return of interest

opening.argument: The presentation does not promise a guaranteed result; it describes returns as variable, explaining that “Some days we'll be high, some days we'll be low.” It also closes with the instruction to “invest responsibly,” which signals that viewers must evaluate risk rather than treat the material as certainty. The speaker presents the figures as illustrations of how the lending schedule and daily averages operate, not as an unconditional outcome for every participant. The available evidence therefore supports conditional investment commentary with an explicit caution, rather than deceptive certification of safety or guaranteed profit.

citations.quote: Some days we'll be high, some days we'll be low.
you guys, as always, invest responsibly
That's why we get that 0.81% average.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited link and lending description establish how the platform was used, but they do not eliminate the video's cautionary language. The return examples are presented alongside an explanation that daily results vary, and the closing instruction expressly tells viewers to invest responsibly. A high illustrative calculation is not itself proof that the speaker represented it as guaranteed.

citations.quote: Some days we'll be high, some days we'll be low.
you guys, as always, invest responsibly

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The variability statement does not make the promotion genuinely cautious: the speaker still highlights “242%” interest and “180% ROI,” while directing viewers to start. Saying results may be high or low describes payout fluctuation, not the risk of losing principal or the possibility that the system may fail. “Invest responsibly” is generic and does not substantiate the unusually large projections.

opening.argument: The video's observable structure is an operational walkthrough: it explains account setup, navigates the dashboard, shows the wallet and exchange, and demonstrates how to place a lending amount and reinvest interest. The speaker repeatedly frames the material as a tutorial, including “BitConnect full tutorial,” and says he will show viewers how the process works. Screens of the platform, calculators, transaction records, and a spreadsheet reinforce a demonstration of procedures rather than a detached promise that viewers will profit. On that reading, the central subject is education about using a financial technology service.

citations.quote: BitConnect full tutorial.
Once you're done setting up, it's going to reroute you to big connects member dashboard, it'll look exactly like this
Once you have your big Connect wallet ready to go go ahead back into your dashboard you are ready to lend out your money
this is a real-time chart I have also included this on the link below in the video

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution interprets procedural instructions as solicitation, but a step-by-step demonstration can explain a platform without establishing that the presenter is certifying the outcome. The speaker shows the mechanics of account setup, exchange, lending, and reinvestment, and presents his own ongoing results as an example. Those features are consistent with an instructional walkthrough whose claims still require independent evaluation.

citations.quote: BitConnect full tutorial.
Once you have your big Connect wallet ready to go go ahead back into your dashboard you are ready to lend out your money

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling it a tutorial does not change what the tutorial instructs viewers to do. It tells them to follow a link, deposit Bitcoin, exchange it for tokens, and lend at specified amounts. The demonstration is therefore operational guidance for entering the investment scheme, while the spreadsheet and dashboard do not prove that projected profits were realized or recoverable.

citations.quote: Go and hit that link to get started.
you have to deposit Bitcoins into there Bitcoin wallet here
you have to buy BIKKONNECT tokens with your bitcoin

opening.argument: The evidence can be read as promotion of an ordinary digital-asset platform and its associated services, not proof of a scam mechanism. The speaker describes exchanging Bitcoin for platform tokens and using a lending interface; the sampled frames show recognizable wallet, exchange, transaction, lending, calculator, and affiliate pages. The material does not establish that viewers were asked for a password, identity credential, or other unauthorized access, nor does it show a completed loss, failed withdrawal, or fabricated transaction. The referral component is expressly described as an affiliate bonus, comparable in the speaker's account to a conventional referral reward. Without those additional facts, the content supports service promotion and operational explanation, not a demonstrated scam.

citations.quote: you have to deposit Bitcoins into there Bitcoin wallet here
it's affiliated bonusing
This is the same exact ordeal.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies deposits, lending, projected returns, and referral compensation, but those elements can also occur in a digital-asset service with an affiliate program. The available material does not show a stolen password, a fabricated account, a failed withdrawal, or an actual unrecovered investment. The speaker's description of an affiliate bonus supplies an ordinary commercial interpretation for the referral feature.

citations.quote: it's affiliated bonusing
This is the same exact ordeal.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A scam classification does not require a stolen password or a recorded failed withdrawal. The central mechanism shown is that viewers send Bitcoin, convert it into platform tokens, commit funds for fixed periods, and are attracted by extraordinary returns. The referral section is not merely a small discount: the speaker says he receives percentages from recruits and further recruits' loans. Platform screens and transaction rows show activity, but they do not establish that the returns or principal were actually safe or sustainable.
